FAQs

Can I use it for small touch-ups?

Yes. Brush it onto prepared areas that need refreshing, without repainting the entire piece.

Will the finish match my existing silver?

Silver shades and shine can vary. Test a hidden spot first to check the match before touching up visible areas.

Do I need professional equipment?

No. You can apply it with a brush, making small touch-ups easy to handle at home.

Will it hide scratches and dents?

It refreshes surface color and appearance. Deep scratches and dents need separate repair for a smoother result.
